scope: N=8 phase-timing wiring and parity validation, not performance qualification

report.build: Bazel opt, all three engine dependencies compiled together
measurement_limits: Process peak RSS includes runtime, fixture, setup and query; it is not a query-only allocation ledger.
Go allocation counts exclude the native engine; run the separately instrumented matrix for native/Python profiles.
Each iteration opens its own store; seeded read runs measure a warm store, not cold artifact reads.
Write cases include a final verification query in query_boundary_ns; write_boundary_ns and read_boundary_ns separate the phases without removing calls.
The query timer excludes the identical checksum algorithm; consumer time is reported separately.
